summary: Crisdel Group is a family-owned heavy civil contractor founded in 1968, headquartered at 220 Ryan Street in South Plainfield, NJ, with a Florida regional office in Tampa. It self-performs paving, sitework, bridge, aviation, marine/port and rail work for public agencies, construction managers and commercial/industrial clients across NJ, NY, PA and FL, and is prequalified with FDOT, NJDOT, NJ Transit, the Turnpike authorities, NYSDOT, PennDOT and PANYNJ. The company is in an active growth phase: it advertises roughly 49 open positions across NJ, FL and a new Virginia market, is hiring across estimating, project management, accounting/compliance and field trades, and runs a $15,000 Summer 2027 scholarship internship.

facts.fact: Corporate headquarters listed as Crisdel Group, Inc., 220 Ryan Street, South Plainfield, NJ 07080, phone 908-561-7550, fax 908-561-6187.
Florida regional office listed at 8985 Palm River Road, Tampa, FL 33619, phone 813-940-3434, fax 813-347-9762.
History page states the firm began in Garwood, NJ in 1968 as Crisdel Construction, and that Frank F. Criscola formed Crisdel Group, Inc. in 1977; his sons joined in 1995 and 2001.

Company describes itself as a family-owned infrastructure contractor providing general contracting and self-performed specialty work across New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania and Florida, including asphalt/concrete paving, heavy highway, site work and underground utilities.

Company says it is prequalified with FDOT, NJDOT, NJ Transit, NJ Turnpike Authority, NYSDOT, NY Thruway Authority, PennDOT, PA Turnpike Commission and the Port Authority of NY & NJ, and is an ISNetworld approved contractor.
Home page lists six market sectors served: aviation, bridge, marine & port, rail facilities, road and sitework.
Emergency repair services are described as available on an on-call basis, 24/7, with an Emergency Response Team that arrives within hours.

The careers page states recruitment is led by the Executive Management Team, includes an embedded job board (LocalJobNetwork) headed 'Crisdel Group, Inc. has the following positions available for immediate hiring,' and directs candidates to employment@crisdel.com.

The syndicated job board for Crisdel listed 'Displaying 1 - 15 of 49 Jobs' with openings in South Plainfield NJ, Tampa FL and Ashburn/Northern Virginia/Sterling VA (Chief Estimator, Estimators, Project Managers, Project Engineer, Superintendents, Pipe/Concrete Foremen, Mechanics, Heavy Construction Laborer, Construction Accounting & Compliance Administrator).

A Summer 2027 program offers a 10-week paid internship split between office/estimating and field/project engineering phases, based in either the NJ/NY or Tampa office, with a $15,000 scholarship; submission deadline February 1.

The internship posting says interns upload drawings to Procore, distribute bid documents, collect subcontractor pricing, perform quantity takeoffs, use AGTEK earthwork software and draft/process RFIs and submittals.

A company blog post says Crisdel has used Topcon GPS Machine Control on its dozers, pavers, excavators, graders and milling machines since about 2013, and that project managers/engineers report using it on more than 50% of job sites.
News page highlights an $81M project upgrading Toronto Blue Jays facilities in Dunedin, Florida at two locations.

operations_signals: Inquiries come through a WordPress/Contact Form 7 web form capturing name, email, phone, a location dropdown (New Jersey / New York / Pennsylvania / Florida) and a free-text message - no project type, budget, schedule or document upload field, and no online booking or quote portal (https://www.crisdel.com/contact-us/).

Phone-and-fax based contact model: separate HQ (908-561-7550) and Tampa (813-940-3434) lines plus fax numbers for each office, and a toll-free number 800-564-8892 in the site header (https://www.crisdel.com/contact-us/).

24/7 on-call emergency response obligation with a team promised to arrive 'within hours' for airports, bridges, ports, rail, roads and tunnels - after-hours intake and dispatch is a standing requirement (https://www.crisdel.com/emergency-repair-services/).

Hiring intake is managed in-house by the HR administrator and executive team: candidates are told to apply via postings on a third-party job network and email resumes to employment@crisdel.com, with no applicant tracking system visible (https://www.crisdel.com/careers/career-opportunities/).

Job listings are delivered through an embedded LocalJobNetwork iframe on the careers page rather than native site pages, so the site itself holds no structured job data (https://www.crisdel.com/careers/career-opportunities/).

Work is bid-driven and compliance-gated: prequalification with nine-plus public agencies (FDOT, NJDOT, NJ Transit, Turnpike, NYSDOT, NYSTA, PennDOT, PTC, PANYNJ) plus ISNetworld approval implies continuous bid, submittal and compliance paperwork (https://www.crisdel.com/company-overview/).

Two-office, multi-state footprint (South Plainfield NJ HQ, Tampa FL regional office) serving NJ, NY, PA and FL, with job postings also in Virginia, so scheduling and crew/resource coordination spans at least four time-relevant geographies (https://www.crisdel.com/contact-us/; https://jobs.localjobnetwork.com/s/e-CRISDEL-GROUP-INC-jobs-e119509.html?pbid=68438).
No published business hours were found on the site; contact page offers phone, fax and a form only (https://www.crisdel.com/contact-us/).
hiring_signals: 49 total openings advertised on the company's syndicated job board, with the first page showing 15 roles across NJ, FL and VA (https://jobs.localjobnetwork.com/s/e-CRISDEL-GROUP-INC-jobs-e119509.html?pbid=68438).

Construction Accounting & Compliance Administrator (South Plainfield, NJ) - an accounting/compliance support seat for the project management and accounting teams (https://jobs.localjobnetwork.com/s/e-CRISDEL-GROUP-INC-jobs-e119509.html?pbid=68438&page=2).

Chief Estimator plus two Estimator (Civil, Heavy/Highway) openings in NJ and VA - bid scoping, pricing and risk evaluation workload is being scaled (https://jobs.localjobnetwork.com/s/e-CRISDEL-GROUP-INC-jobs-e119509.html?pbid=68438).

Two Project Manager, two Project Superintendent and a Project Engineer (VA) openings - project administration and document control load (https://jobs.localjobnetwork.com/s/e-CRISDEL-GROUP-INC-jobs-e119509.html?pbid=68438).

Mechanic / Small Tool & Engine Mechanic roles in Tampa and South Plainfield - equipment maintenance and parts/inventory tracking (https://jobs.localjobnetwork.com/s/e-CRISDEL-GROUP-INC-jobs-e119509.html?pbid=68438).

Field craft hiring: Pipe Foreman and Concrete Foreman (VA) and Heavy Construction Laborer (Tampa) (https://jobs.localjobnetwork.com/s/e-CRISDEL-GROUP-INC-jobs-e119509.html?pbid=68438; https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=Crisdel).

Summer 2027 scholarship internship ($15,000, 10 weeks, NJ/NY or Tampa) promoted in a site-wide header banner reading 'Summer 2027 internship applications now open' (https://www.crisdel.com/summer-2027-internship/).

Named HR contact for recruiting and benefits questions is the Human Resource Administrator, who handles onboarding, benefits, FMLA, ACA/1095 and 401k reporting (https://www.crisdel.com/management-team/).
review_themes: No customer review content could be retrieved from public review platforms during this research (Indeed, Glassdoor, Yelp, Trustpilot, BBB and Yellow Pages all returned 403/bot blocks), so no theme can be stated with evidence; for this firm the public buying signal is agency prequalification and bid wins rather than consumer ratings (https://www.crisdel.com/company-overview/).
tech_footprint: Website runs WordPress with a Visual Composer/WPBakery-style page builder theme, Yoast SEO plugin and Contact Form 7 for inquiry capture (https://www.crisdel.com/contact-us/).
Google Analytics is installed on the site; no live chat, chatbot or scheduling widget was observed on the pages reviewed (https://www.crisdel.com/contact-us/).
Procore is used for drawing uploads and bid document distribution; AGTEK is used for earthwork cut/fill and quantity takeoffs (https://www.crisdel.com/summer-2027-internship/).
Topcon GPS Machine Control (including Millimeter GPS) is deployed on dozers, excavators, graders, pavers and milling machines across most job sites (https://www.crisdel.com/blog/topcon-gps-mc/).
ISNetworld is used as the contractor safety/compliance platform (https://www.crisdel.com/company-overview/).

Job postings are outsourced to a LocalJobNetwork embed, and the site publishes a projects portfolio, blog and news pages rather than data or client portals (https://www.crisdel.com/careers/career-opportunities/; https://www.crisdel.com/news-media/).
growth_signals: Job postings extend beyond the four marketed states into Ashburn, Sterling and Northern Virginia, indicating a new mid-Atlantic operating area (https://jobs.localjobnetwork.com/s/e-CRISDEL-GROUP-INC-jobs-e119509.html?pbid=68438).

Florida office has been operating since 2016 and is staffed by Tampa Bay-area managers; the company now recruits mechanics and laborers there alongside project staff (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=Crisdel).

Project scale includes an $81M Toronto Blue Jays spring-training facilities upgrade in Dunedin, FL, alongside aviation work at Tampa Airport/SkyCenter and Newark Airport Terminal A (https://www.crisdel.com/news-media/; https://www.crisdel.com/blog/topcon-gps-mc/).

Website and brand were refreshed in 2025-2026 (new logo, Tampa photo set, new Summer 2027 scholarship page, header banner for internship applications) (https://www.crisdel.com/history/; https://www.crisdel.com/summer-2027-internship/).

Leadership is publicly active in trade associations: the President/COO is UTCA President-Elect for 2026-2027 and chairs UTCA labor negotiation and Department of Labor committees (https://www.crisdel.com/management-team/).

Company states it is a second-generation, family-run firm now planning succession into a third generation while 'rejecting the status quo' and continually improving operations (https://www.crisdel.com/management-team/).
decision_maker: Frank A. Criscola, President and Chief Operating Officer, listed on the company's own management team page (https://www.crisdel.com/management-team/); Michael J. Criscola, Executive Vice President, is listed as responsible for business development and customer relations on the same page.

inferences.inference: Estimating is a bottleneck: adding a Chief Estimator plus two estimators in two regions suggests bid volume is outpacing capacity and that takeoff/scope-review work is a candidate for AI-assisted automation.
inferences.reasoning: Three estimating requisitions are open simultaneously across NJ and VA, and the internship description shows takeoffs, subcontractor pricing requests and RFI drafting are still largely manual steps performed by staff.

inferences.inference: A meaningful share of back-office effort is compliance paperwork rather than finance strategy.
inferences.reasoning: The new Construction Accounting & Compliance Administrator role is scoped to support both project management and accounting, and the HR administrator's listed duties already cover FMLA, ACA 1095 reporting, 401k deduction reporting and new-hire agency filings - classic document-extraction and deadline-tracking work.

inferences.inference: After-hours inquiry handling is likely a weak point.
inferences.reasoning: The firm promises 24/7 on-call emergency response with arrival 'within hours', yet the only intake channels published are office phone numbers, fax and a static web form with no routing logic or acknowledgement - so after-hours calls land in voicemail with no triage layer.

inferences.inference: Inbound project inquiries are not qualified at intake.
inferences.reasoning: The contact form collects only name, email, phone, state and free text; with no project type, scope, budget or file upload, staff must chase the same missing details by phone or email for every lead.

inferences.inference: Recruiting throughput is a constraint given the number of openings versus a single HR administrator.
inferences.reasoning: Forty-nine advertised requisitions across three regions are handled by one HR administrator plus the executive team, with resumes arriving by email and no visible applicant tracking system.

inferences.inference: The Virginia postings point to a deliberate geographic expansion that will strain existing NJ-based estimating, PM and safety oversight.
inferences.reasoning: Multiple VA roles (project engineer, PM, superintendent, estimator, pipe and concrete foremen) are posted together, which is the pattern of standing up a new operating area rather than a one-off project hire.

inferences.inference: The company is receptive to technology adoption, which shortens sales cycles for AI tooling.
inferences.reasoning: It publicly markets Procore, AGTEK and Topcon GPS machine control use, and the CEO's bio explicitly credits 'implementation of business systems and technology' as part of his remit.

data_gaps: Employee headcount and annual revenue are not published on the site; no registry or database source could be opened to verify size during this research.

Customer and employee review data unavailable: Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Yelp, Trustpilot, BBB and Yellow Pages all returned HTTP 403 or bot challenges, so no ratings or review themes could be sourced.
LinkedIn company page (provided by the mapper) returned HTTP 403 and could not be read for headcount or posting history.
Only the first 15 of 49 job postings were visible; pagination parameters did not return additional pages, so the full role mix and posting dates are unknown.
No business hours listed anywhere on the site; after-hours phone coverage is only implied by the 24/7 emergency response claim.
No named contact for estimating/preconstruction beyond 'Head of Preconstruction' title; no direct email for business development was found.

The site's own pages for services such as emergency repair and company overview render inconsistently; content was verified through the site's WordPress REST API instead, which is the same underlying content.
